name: aplomo
description: A repository-aware engineering workflow for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Keep coding agents aligned with repository conventions.
interface.longDescription: Aplomo guides coding agents to understand module boundaries, reuse existing patterns, review implementation plans, and inspect final diffs before completing non-trivial repository changes.
defaultPrompt: Review my implementation plan against the repository's existing architecture.
Find the existing pattern I should extend before I add this feature.
Review the current diff for architectural and testing risks.
